## About
Asiaworks is a Honda and Acura shop on Sparta Ave in Charlotte. We handle scheduled maintenance, diagnostic testing and repairs, and if you drive another Japanese model, give us a call and ask.
We use Genuine Honda Parts or parts made by their vendors to save you money, and when it makes sense we'll suggest used parts as an option. We stand behind our work, and our technicians are happy to answer your questions.
Customers have given us 4.6 stars across 162 Google reviews. Stop by, call, or send us a note about what your car needs.

## Services
- Scheduled vehicle maintenance: Regular maintenance on your Honda or Acura to catch problems before they start.
- Air conditioning repair and maintenance: Keeping your air conditioning working through Charlotte summers.
- Emissions testing and repair: Emissions testing, plus repairs if your car needs them.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on cars other than Honda and Acura?
A: Our focus is Honda and Acura. For other Japanese models, please call and ask about your car.

Q: What kind of parts do you use?
A: We use Genuine Honda Parts or parts made by their vendors to save you money. When it's appropriate, we'll also suggest used parts as an alternative to new.

Q: How do I get an estimate?
A: Fill out the free estimate form on our contact page and we'll get back to you, or call us to schedule a consultation or get an estimate.
